exposure.needed: whether dashboards, alerts or recording rules reference querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total or querier_cache_misses_total

consequence.statement: The three querier_cache_* metrics are no longer emitted; anything relying on them must use loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds, which instrument requests to the configured cache (embeddedcache, memcached or redis).
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards and alerts to the loki_cache_* metrics.

assertion.statement: The embedded cache metrics querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total and querier_cache_misses_total are removed in favour of loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds.
